questions: Does Assay meet RQS-2030 for an agent harness? Partly: strong durability, identity, evidence and injection design with CI gates; held back by an approval bypass in the external-probe path, unproven live claims, red CI on the reviewed commit, no releases or provenance, and a one-owner, no-review process.

Are the README's headline numbers supported? The model-free numbers are measured and gated but two drifted from the committed results; the live M12 numbers recompute from live.json, but the grader credits only Assay for facts in claim params (answer-only 88 vs 90), the baseline is not in the repo, and the only run on the reviewed code has an interval crossing parity.
Is CI green on HEAD across platforms? No: on 9373f4d the Linux check failed at lint and skipped every later gate, macOS passed, and Windows has never passed (hangs up to 9373f4d, failures after).
Does every effectful path go through approval? No: assay_probe (effect read) can run external tools, including `npx -y`, with the full environment and no consent check.

Does the durable kernel survive SIGKILL without losing evidence or duplicating keyed effects? Yes for the kernel (fault-injection test in CI, M1 32 kills, 0 re-executed steps); agent turns and workers are settled, not resumed.
